module.giveaway.name: TSQ Giveaway
module.giveaway.description: Reaction giveaways: /giveaway create opens a form, members enter with 🎉, winners are drawn automatically when time is up.
cmd.giveaway.create: Start a giveaway in this channel (opens a form)
cmd.giveaway.end: End an active giveaway now and draw the winners
cmd.giveaway.end.giveaway: Giveaway number (#12), message link or message ID
cmd.giveaway.cancel: Cancel an active giveaway without drawing
cmd.giveaway.cancel.giveaway: Giveaway number (#12), message link or message ID
cmd.giveaway.reroll: Draw new winners for a finished giveaway
cmd.giveaway.reroll.giveaway: Giveaway number (#12), message link or message ID
giveaway.form.title: 🎉 Create Giveaway
giveaway.form.prize_hint: What the winner gets (at most 100 characters)
giveaway.form.duration_hint: Minutes (m), hours (h), days (d). At least 1 minute, at most 30 days.
giveaway.form.description_placeholder: The prize will be sent via Steam.
giveaway.form.description_hint: Shown on the card below the prize (at most 500 characters)
giveaway.form.winners_invalid: ❌ **Number of winners** must be a number from {0} to {1}.
giveaway.create.no_reaction: ✅ Giveaway started (#{0}, ends {1}), but the bot could not add the 🎉 reaction. The bot needs **Add Reactions** in this channel; members can still enter by adding 🎉 themselves.
giveaway.create.post_failed: ❌ The giveaway card could not be posted in this channel; the giveaway was not started. Check the bot's channel permissions and try again.
giveaway.create.post_uncertain: ⚠️ Discord did not confirm the card; the giveaway was not started. If a card appeared in the channel, delete it and try again.
giveaway.create.limit: ❌ This server can have at most {0} active giveaways at a time.
giveaway.create.channel_type: ❌ Giveaways can only be started in text channels the bot can see.
giveaway.create.channel_permissions: ❌ The bot cannot run a giveaway in this channel. Missing bot permissions: {0}
giveaway.not_found: ❌ Giveaway not found. Use the giveaway number (#12), a message link or a message ID.
giveaway.state.finished: ℹ️ This giveaway has already been drawn.
giveaway.state.orphaned: ℹ️ This giveaway's message or channel was deleted; nothing can be done with it.
giveaway.end.no_entrants: ✅ Giveaway #{0} ended, but there were no valid entrants.
giveaway.end.not_due: ℹ️ This giveaway has not ended yet.
giveaway.end.retry: ⚠️ The entrants could not be read from Discord right now; the giveaway stays active and will be retried automatically.
giveaway.end.message_missing: ❌ The giveaway message or channel was deleted; the giveaway was closed without a draw.
giveaway.reroll.done_fewer: ✅ Drew {1} new winner(s) for giveaway #{0} (there were no more valid entrants besides the previous winners).
giveaway.reroll.not_finished: ❌ Only a drawn giveaway can be rerolled.
giveaway.reroll.no_candidates: ❌ There are no valid entrants besides the previous winners; the winners stay the same.
giveaway.reroll.unavailable: ⚠️ The entrants could not be read from Discord right now; the winners stay the same. Try again shortly.
giveaway.reroll.message_missing: ❌ The giveaway message was deleted; its reactions cannot be read, so it cannot be rerolled.
giveaway.reroll.conflict: ⚠️ This giveaway was changed by another action at the same time; try again.
giveaway.card.no_entrants: The giveaway ended, but there were no valid entrants.
giveaway.privacy.started: your name and id are removed from {0} giveaway(s) you started
giveaway.privacy.ended: your id is removed from {0} giveaway(s) you ended or cancelled
